text_block_list.name: Ines Fan A
text_block_list.text: I heard Ines gets savage when yourun with her! I bet you've never donethat, right?

text_block_list.name: Ryan Fan A
text_block_list.text: Huh? Well, have you ever worked outwith Ryan?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
On the way to our next training<n>session, Ines Fujin
and I stumble<n>across a curious spat between fans.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yep... And it sounds like it's over me<n>and Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'll go monitor the situation from<n>where they can't
see me. If I<n>wouldn't want to add fuel to the fire<n>by
getting involved.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Host
text_block_list.text:
Silence, please. Moving forward, raise<n>your hand if
you wish to speak. Now,<n>without further ado...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Host
text_block_list.text:
Let us officially begin the fourth<n>"Would You Rather
Have Ines or Ryan<n>as Your Big Sister?" debate!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to present my pro-Ines<n>argument! For
context, I must roll the<n>clock back to a few days
ago...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Phew! See? There's nothing like a<n>good run to clear
your worries!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You want to thank me with a<n>gift? Don't
sweat it! I had fun! Let's<n>run again sometime,
y'know, to clear<n>our heads.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, I knew it! Ines's kindness<n>and humility are
on another level!

text_block_list.name: Ryan Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Mrrgh... I would like to present my<n>own argument in
Ryan's favor! Now,<n>this all happened during a
workout<n>session...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Don't give up! Look at your biceps...<n>And listen to
what they have to say.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's okay—I'm right behind you. I'll<n>spot you if get
into any trouble!

text_block_list.name: Ryan Fan B
text_block_list.text: You must've felt so at ease! Ryan'sjust so reliable!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fan A
text_block_list.text: Why, you... Well I've been saving anargument that's gonna knock youright out!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yikes! I don't like where this is<n>heading... Time to
step in!

text_block_list.name: Ines & Ryan
text_block_list.text: You shouldn't fight! Fighting is<n>wrong!

text_block_list.name: Ines & Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wait... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Debate Club Students
text_block_list.text: Ines?! Ryan?! Wh-what in the world<n>is...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Guys, listen up! I get how you feel. I<n>really do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: But fighting's not the answer. I mean,<n>Ines and I...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
We get along like peanut butter and<n>jelly-elly! And I
want you guys to<n>have that same relationship.

text_block_list.name: Debate Club Students
text_block_list.text: Eep! They're standing next to eachother! I can't believe we're getting tosee this up close!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Weren't you just about to fight<n>each other?

text_block_list.name: Ryan Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh. Nope, this happens all the time!<n>Once the
debate heats up, we end up<n>getting pretty intense!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fan A
text_block_list.text:
She's right. When you two are the<n>topic of
discussion, we all turn into a<n>bunch of
motormouths...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, that is reassuring... but, uh,<n>I'm feeling
pretty embarrassed<n>about... all of this.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It seems that Ines and Ryan's<n>everyday behavior
has captivated<n>enough people to inspire an
organized<n>debate community. ...I can see why<n>they
might feel a little flustered.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Sigh... These underclassmen of mineare just so...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Adorably cute!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hm? What is it? What's with the<n>confusion?
choice_data_list:
It's just... You hardly seem bothered by any of
this...

It's just... You hardly seem bothered by any of
this...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Yep, not at all, not at all! I'm used<n>to stuff like
this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Makes sense, seeing how you've<n>got all those
years of big sister<n>experience under your belt!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeahhh. And as a big sister to these<n>girls, I couldn't
be happier. ♪ It makes<n>me want to repay the favor
somehow!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
What do you think would be good,<n>Trainer? I want
to thank my adorable<n>admirers!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ooh. We've still got some time before<n>training, so
why not! ♪

text_block_list.name: Debate Club Students
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Would you like to come too,<n>Ryan? We'd love
to see you there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'll come for sure. Oh, but... try<n>to keep the
compliments to a<n>minimum, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, surrounded by members of<n>the debate club,
the two idols enjoy a<n>wonderful tea party.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Would that be enough? I mean, I'll<n>greet as many
people as you can<n>bring, but...

text_block_list.name: Debate Club Students
text_block_list.text: You really get it, Trainer! This is thebest present we could have askedfor! We'd better make sure everyonegets to attend this one!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wait, there are other members<n>besides you guys?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's great! Invite as many<n>members as you like!
No number's<n>out of the question for this big sis. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Although confronted with an<n>unexpectedly huge
horde of<n>members, Ines Fujin meets and<n>greets
them all with a caring and<n>sisterly attitude.
